anchor_text: <Dialogue speaker="Fr. Andrew Stephen Damick" time="01:09:46">Welcome back to the Lord of Spirits podcast. I am [[Father Andrew]] Stephen Damick in Emmaus, Pennsylvania, and my co-host [[Father Stephen]] De Young is with me from Lafayette, Louisiana.</Dialogue>
<Dialogue speaker="Fr. Stephen De Young" time="47:52">And not not in Middle-earth. I knew you were going to try and go there.</Dialogue>
<Dialogue speaker="Fr. Andrew Stephen Damick" time="07:31:45">Thank you. Good night. [[God]] bless you all.</Dialogue>
